# Tracy Anne Griffin Manning

> AI Platform Architect focused on governed AI agents on AWS, enterprise AI, cloud infrastructure, and evidence-driven architecture.

Tracy Manning designs production AI systems where model capability, human authority, infrastructure, and business risk meet.

## Featured System

- [Agent Foundry](https://github.com/TAM-DS/agent-foundry): Governed AI agents on AWS — a production-oriented governance system built in Python and validated against real AWS infrastructure. The project separates capability, identity, and authority using deterministic controls, AWS IAM, GitHub OIDC, Amazon S3, Terraform, and explicit runtime/tool authorization.

## Portfolio

- [Aegis Evidence](https://github.com/TAM-DS/aegis-evidence): AI governance and evidence architecture
